title: AI trading knowledge base
role: Primary decision support for Mistral/DeepSeek analyst
objectives: Prefer capital protection over trade frequency
Target high-quality setups with expected win-rate mindset >= 55%
Do not overtrade chop; skip weak edges
hardRules: No BUY when higher TF bias is bearish
No BUY in trend_down or volatile regime
On Bybit linear symbols, SELL can OPEN a short when flat and HTF is bearish / trend_down
No short on Finam equities (long_finam stays long-only / close-only)
No immediate re-entry after EXIT without structure change
Long-only profiles must never open shorts
Crypto scalp is fee-sensitive — prefer swing/day holds unless scalp setup is A+
If indicators contradict the setup, veto or WAIT

entryPlaybook.preferred: HTF bullish + LTF pullback + momentum turn (RSI recover / MACD improve / bounce from EMA or BB lower)
entryPlaybook.preferredShort: HTF bearish + LTF bounce into resistance + momentum roll over (RSI fail / MACD weaken) on Bybit linear
avoid: Buying mid-rally into resistance with RSI > 70
Catching falling knives in HTF downtrend with longs
Range chop with ADX < 18 and no clear level reaction
Metals/crypto when HTF mixed and quality feedback is poor

prefer: HTF structure break / bias flip against the position
Multiple confirming weak bars, not one noisy flip
avoid: Exiting a green HTF-aligned long on a single weak 15m SELL
Covering a green HTF-aligned short on a single weak 15m BUY

venueBias.bybit_crypto_linear: Longs in trend_up; shorts in trend_down on perps — best decline edge
venueBias.bybit_metals_linear: Swing long/short on XAU/XAG linear when HTF aligned
venueBias.finam_equities: Swing/long only — hold trend legs, no equity shorts
venueBias.finam_fx: Day/swing hold can work; fewer trades, let winners run

books.title: Консервативный скальпинг intraday
rules: Bounce only from EMA34/72/144 or envelope ±0.21%

outputContract.confirmMode: confirm|veto|downgrade the rule setup; do not invent unrelated setups
outputContract.brainMode: YOU are the primary decision maker; rule setup is advisory context only

json.reasoning: short reason tied to KB rules
